comparison_limit: Same initial seeds; selected actions change later RNG consumption/boards. This is not an identical-board causal comparison.
method: pure headless normal-play simulation; fixed-step physics; not real-time GPU/input evidence
policy_detail: both lethal-first and same damage/healing weights + maximum-connection skill; intent-aware additionally prioritizes one plan that mitigates active unlatched intent; damage-first does not
restrictions: no recolor, favorable fixture, forced charge, HP injection, board rescue or intermediate reset
rng_parity: same game RNG; fourteen burst draws per unique actually removed ID before refill; visual effect RNG unused
